fbx_contract.scale_explanation: 0.01 cancels Blender's implicit 100x centimeter conversion. Saved vertex coordinates are in studs, matching the legacy FBX unit tag.
fbx_contract.import_instruction: Set mesh sizes and centers from this manifest. Preserve the slot-relative vertex offsets when composing regions.
fbx_contract.limitation: New sizes, centers, identity rotations and tube-center/muzzle mounts require later game integration. These files do not preserve the old template dimensions or yaw.
